name: Service Contracts
nameTh: สัญญาบริการ MA
description: Maintenance (MA) service contracts for service companies: customer contracts with covered equipment/sites (asset, serial, location), SLA level (response/resolve hours, 8x5 or 24x7 coverage), billing plan (one-time, monthly, quarterly, yearly) with an installment schedule to invoice, preventive-maintenance visits generated from the PM frequency with a checklist template, technician assignment, pass/fail results and customer sign-off on a printable service report, coverage lookup by serial or customer, renewal with price uplift and a 60-day expiry list with alerts.
